ibd-fbe62ca502c7a6db-q10:whole.text: Conservation of energy gives mgh = ½mv² + ½Iω². Rolling without slipping gives ω = v/r. Substituting I = 2mr²/5 gives mgh = ½mv² + ⅕mv² = 7mv²/10, hence v = √(10gh/7).
